verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a banking-infrastructure API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents batch or bulk endpoints, such as bulk payments, bulk card issuance, or batch account creation. Mentions of multi-party fund flows, the API, Postman collections and the sandbox describe single-resource capabilities or developer tooling, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
